messages.content:
How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?
Version: 6.3.1
IP: 192.120.45.67
API name: get information of an interface
Parameter_fabricName: Network1
Parameter_nodeId: 12
Parameter_podId: 10
Parameter_interfaceType: Ethernet
Parameter_infoType: Speed

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Send a GET request to retrieve specified information for an interface from a network telemetry API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL endpoint to send the GET request to. This should include the base path without query parameters, e.g., 'https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'.

params.description: The query parameters for the request.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric to limit nodes pertaining to.

nodeId.description: The node identifier to limit results pertaining to.

podId.description: The pod identifier to limit results pertaining to.

interfaceType.description: The type of the interface to limit results pertaining to.

infoType.description: The type of information requested for the interface.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard? Version: 6.3.1 IP: 192.120.45.67 API name: get information of an interface Parameter_fabricName: Network1 Parameter_nodeId: 12 Parameter_podId: 10 Parameter_interfaceType: Ethernet Parameter_infoType: Speed"

We need to respond with the correct JSON format for the function call. The function is requests_get. We need to provide the URL and params. The base path is something like 'https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'. The IP is 192.120.45.67. So URL: 'https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'.

Params: fabricName: "Network1", nodeId: 12, podId: 10, interfaceType: "Ethernet", infoType: "Speed". But note that interfaceType expects one of "gigabitethernet" | "fastethernet" | "ethernet" | "serial". The user gave "Ethernet" capitalized. The expected values are lowercase? The spec says interfaceType: "gigabitethernet" | "fastethernet" | "ethernet" | "serial". So we should use "ethernet". Also infoType expects "statistics" | "status" | "config" | "Speed". The last one is "Speed" with capital S. The spec shows "Speed" with capital S. So we keep "Speed".

Thus we produce JSON:

{
  "url": "https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo",
  "params": {
    "fabricName": "Network1",
    "nodeId": 12,
    "podId": 10,
    "interfaceType": "ethernet",
    "infoType": "Speed"
  }
}

We need to output exactly that JSON.
